module_dispositions.rationale: Defines character, ordinary, internal, assignment, and main-control command-code partitions consumed by raw and expanded delivery; §210 remains conditionals-owned.
Defines six signed modes, semantic-list fields, auxiliary interpretations, append invariant, and initial outer vertical state.
Executable push_nest and pop_nest state transitions.
Observable show_activities walk and mode-specific auxiliary rendering.
Hash representation and initialization definitions.
Lookup, collision traversal, guarded creation, and insertion.
Hash sizing and diagnostic rendering context.
Primitive name and meaning installation.
Primitive enumeration belongs to individual command domains.
Stored token and macro-template vocabulary.
Diagnostic rendering and syntactic overview.
Input state, scanner status, and ownership.
Diagnostic context formatting.
Generic input-stack push preserves the current record.
Generic current-input retirement restores the immediately enclosing record.
Stored token-list level creation and parameter ownership setup.
Token-list exhaustion releases reference and macro-parameter ownership before popping.
Backup, insertion, error replay, and file-level creation.
File-level close restores source nesting and line state before popping.
Input-stack capacity and initial terminal/root setup.
Raw current-token contract.
Scanner-status recovery.
Raw dispatch and alignment interception.
Physical and stored token delivery.
Expanded delivery and expandable primitives.
Macro matching and replacement replay.
Converted and the-toks token lists.
Read-stream token-list construction.
Canonical input filename retry/open lifecycle, job-name initialization, source-level registration, and first-line normalization.

properties.claim: Command codes preserve TeX82's numeric partitions: catcode-derived characters precede ordinary commands, min_internal through max_internal delimit the quantities accepted by the, and max_command separates main-control delivery from expandable/internal-only meanings.
preconditions: The TeX82 primitive registry and exact command-code vocabulary are installed.
stimulus: Phase 2 unit `command_code_partition_classifies_character_internal_unexpandable_and_expandable_ranges` exercises every boundary and alias; minifixture `command-code-boundaries.tex` observes representative raw and expanded identities on each side.

cases: pinned first mismatch rejects XPASS and changed failure

expected_observations: Aliases share their required numeric code, internal quantities occupy the inclusive canonical interval, and commands above max_command never reach main control unexpanded.
postconditions: Delivery and scanner classification use the canonical partition without renumbering by Rust enum order.
equivalence_cases: Character catcodes and their same-number non-character aliases remain distinguishable by input origin; every internal family uses the same inclusive boundary test.
recovery_cases: Undefined and dont_expand meanings remain above max_command and are handled by expansion rather than ordinary execution.

properties.claim: The semantic nest represents outer/internal vertical, paragraph/restricted horizontal, and display/inline math as signed modes with one current list record whose head, tail, prev_graf, auxiliary value, and entry line retain their mode-specific meanings.
preconditions: Execution begins before any nested box, paragraph, math list, or output routine is entered.
stimulus: Phase 2 unit `semantic_nest_six_modes_and_fields_initialize_canonically` constructs every signed mode, empty/nonempty list, auxiliary interpretation, and initial contribution state.
expected_observations: Outer vertical mode begins on contrib_head with ignored prev_depth; head/tail agree exactly for an empty list; mode arithmetic selects one of three families while sign selects outer versus internal form.
postconditions: Appending one node advances tail and preserves the list head; mode_line and auxiliary storage remain attached to the active record.
equivalence_cases: Positive and negative modes in one family share field layout but not semantic scope; empty lists in all six modes share head-equals-tail.
recovery_cases: An invalid mode or incompatible auxiliary interpretation is rejected at the typed boundary rather than silently projected as another mode.

properties.claim: push_nest saves the complete current list record and starts one empty nested list with zero prev_graf and the current input line; pop_nest frees that nested head and restores the immediately enclosing record.
preconditions: A valid current list exists; pop is requested only above the bottom level after nested material ownership is resolved.
stimulus: Phase 2 unit `semantic_nest_push_and_pop_preserve_fields_and_start_empty_list` nests all mode families, mutates each inner field, and unwinds to exact saved records.
expected_observations: Push preserves old mode and auxiliary values in the saved record but gives the child a fresh empty head/tail, zero prev_graf, and current line; pop restores every saved field.
postconditions: Nest depth changes by exactly one and the abandoned child head is released exactly once.
equivalence_cases: Repeated push/pop pairs preserve equivalent records across all six modes; nested empty and nonempty children restore the same parent state.
recovery_cases: Bottom-level pop and capacity overflow fail explicitly without fabricating or partially restoring a record.

properties.claim: show_activities visits semantic levels from current to outermost and renders each signed mode, absolute entry line, output-routine marker, list contents, and mode-specific auxiliary fields in canonical order.
preconditions: The semantic nest contains valid records and diagnostic list rendering is available.
stimulus: Phase 2 unit `show_activities_reports_each_mode_auxiliary_and_entry_line` plus minifixture `mode-activities.tex` cover vertical prevdepth/prevgraf, horizontal spacefactor/language, math incomplete fraction, output routine, page status, and contributions.

cases: pinned first mismatch rejects XPASS and changed failure

expected_observations: Levels print innermost first; negative mode_line marks output; only the auxiliary fields meaningful for that mode are rendered.
postconditions: Diagnostic traversal does not change semantic nest or list ownership.
equivalence_cases: Empty and populated lists preserve level ordering; ignored and finite prevdepth use their distinct canonical spellings.
recovery_cases: Absent optional language, incomplete fraction, page, or contribution data suppresses only its own diagnostic clause.

properties.claim: Multiletter lookup reuses a stable identity; guarded misses remain undefined and permitted misses insert one persistent spelling.
preconditions: The exact TeX82 profile and explicit canonical command state are active.
stimulus: Phase 2 unit `lookup_reuses_existing_identity_and_guarded_miss_does_not_intern` plus minifixture `input-control-sequences.tex` cover equal/colliding names and guarded/permitted misses.
expected_observations: Only a permitted miss interns; source and csname lookup of equal bytes share identity.
postconditions: Consumed input, scanner status, and replay ownership end at the cited canonical boundary.
equivalence_cases: Repeated equal spellings and distinct spellings with the same initial hash probe exercise reuse versus collision traversal; source control words and csname-created names converge only after both permit creation.
recovery_cases: A guarded miss returns undefined_control_sequence without interning; an exhausted hash reports capacity overflow rather than aliasing or replacing an existing identity.

properties.claim: Primitive installation binds canonical spelling, level-one command, and operand, using direct identities for single-character primitives.
preconditions: The exact TeX82 profile and explicit canonical command state are active.
stimulus: Phase 2 unit `primitive_installation_binds_spelling_command_operand_and_level` installs single- and multiletter primitives.
expected_observations: Later raw resolution returns exactly the installed command and operand.
postconditions: Consumed input, scanner status, and replay ownership end at the cited canonical boundary.
equivalence_cases: Single-character primitives use direct identities while multiletter primitives use the hash, but both install the same level/command/operand triple and later raw resolution contract.
recovery_cases: Reinstalling an initialization spelling reuses its identity; hash-capacity failure is fatal before a partially installed primitive becomes visible.

properties.claim: Stored lists distinguish character and control-sequence tokens and encode match, end-match, and output-parameter forms without re-tokenization.
preconditions: The exact TeX82 profile and explicit canonical command state are active.
stimulus: Existing vocabulary tests cover canonical names and compact parameter forms; Phase 2 units `stored_token_encoding_partitions_characters_controls_and_macro_forms` and `stored_token_reference_lifetime_survives_redefinition_and_replay`, plus minifixture `stored-token-replay.tex`, cover numeric partitions, brace/match limits, reference ownership, and replay after redefinition.
expected_observations: Token kind, parameter role, and one-based selector remain distinct.
postconditions: Consumed input, scanner status, and replay ownership end at the cited canonical boundary.
equivalence_cases: Character and control-sequence tokens that resolve to the same current command retain distinct stored encodings; match, end-match, literal mac_param, and out_param remain distinct even when character operands coincide.
recovery_cases: Definition scanning rejects excess or invalid output-parameter selectors before publication; malformed stored forms are never reinterpreted as ordinary character tokens.

properties.claim: Source and stored-token levels form one LIFO stack; exhaustion retires one level, macro bodies own argument ranges, and backup precedes underlying input.
preconditions: At least one retained source or stored-token level is active, with scanner status and parameter stack explicitly initialized.
stimulus: Existing stack tests exercise stored replay ownership; Phase 2 units `source_level_begin_end_restore_line_and_terminal_state`, `token_list_kind_reference_and_parameter_stack_lifecycle_matrix`, and `backup_inserted_and_macro_levels_retire_in_canonical_order`, plus minifixture `input-level-lifecycle.tex`, cover the remaining source and token-list assertions.

cases: pinned first mismatch rejects XPASS and changed failure

expected_observations: Newest input delivers first; every token-list kind applies its canonical reference/parameter action; source close restores line, terminal/file state, and enclosing cursor; replay selects the nearest live parameter owner.
postconditions: Each exhausted level retires exactly once and resumes the enclosing level at its unchanged next position.
equivalence_cases: File and terminal source levels share stack ordering but retain distinct close/context state; backed-up and inserted singleton lists share delivery order but not diagnostic kind; macro body, argument, and parameter replay retain distinct ownership actions.
recovery_cases: Input-stack and parameter-stack overflow are bounded capacity failures; stale retirement is rejected without popping another level; back_error reports before replaying the offending token.

properties.claim: Retiring input restores the immediately enclosing record; token-list retirement releases exactly its reference or macro-parameter ownership, while file retirement closes the source and restores input nesting and saved line state before the common pop.
preconditions: A non-bottom input level is exhausted or final cleanup has selected that exact top level for canonical retirement.
stimulus: Phase 2 unit `input_level_retirement_covers_source_token_parameter_and_reference_actions` exhausts every stored-list kind and nested source; final_cleanup may cross-reference this property while retaining exclusive ownership of §1335.
expected_observations: Token references and macro parameter ranges are released before their level disappears; file close decrements nesting and restores the saved line; the common pop exposes exactly the prior record.
postconditions: One level retires exactly once, no retired ownership remains live, and the enclosing cursor is unchanged.
equivalence_cases: Backed-up and inserted lists need no reference action; macro body and parameter lists release distinct ownership; terminal and file levels share common pop but only file retirement closes a source and restores nesting.
recovery_cases: Bottom-level retirement and a mismatched level identity fail without popping; final cleanup repeats the same one-level operation until the bottom input is reached rather than bypassing kind-specific release.

properties.claim: Raw delivery sets one current command/token, updates literal-brace alignment state, and intercepts only active top-level alignment delimiters.
preconditions: The exact TeX82 profile and explicit canonical command state are active.
expected_observations: One raw event precedes expansion and an intercepted delimiter does not escape as ordinary continuation.
postconditions: Consumed input, scanner status, and replay ownership end at the cited canonical boundary.
equivalence_cases: Equal source and stored tokens resolve to the same current command, but only source tokens carry freshly scanned spelling; braces at nested alignment depth deliver normally while top-level tab/car_ret delimiters enter template delivery.
recovery_cases: Outer controls and source EOF delegate to check_outer_validity before another raw token is requested; inactive alignment delimiters remain ordinary commands rather than being consumed structurally.

properties.claim: Raw delivery checks outer controls and EOF against scanner status and performs one status-specific finite recovery.
preconditions: The exact TeX82 profile and explicit canonical command state are active.
stimulus: Phase 2 unit `outer_validity_recovery_is_scanner_status_specific_and_finite` plus minifixture `input-outer-recovery.tex` cover skipping, matching, defining, aligning, and absorbing.
expected_observations: Runaway context and canonical recovery tokens occur once before resumable input.
postconditions: Consumed input, scanner status, and replay ownership end at the cited canonical boundary.
equivalence_cases: Skipping, defining, matching, aligning, and absorbing share the outer-validity entry point but insert distinct recovery tokens; token-list and eligible source outer controls are backed up while read-stream controls are not.
recovery_cases: EOF has no token to back up; matching inserts par, alignment inserts frozen_cr plus right brace, skipping inserts frozen_fi, and every branch restores deletions_allowed after one diagnostic.

properties.claim: Raw input implements TeX82's M/N/S tokenizer, control-name scanning, superscript reduction, refill, stored replay, output-parameter substitution, and guarded lookup.
preconditions: An exact-byte source line or stored-token level is current; live catcodes, endlinechar, scanner status, and control-sequence creation policy are fixed for the next delivery boundary.
stimulus: Existing tokenizer tests cover physical M/N/S and superscript behavior; Phase 2 units `stored_get_next_substitutes_parameters_and_resolves_meanings`, `force_eof_and_refill_retire_only_at_line_boundary`, `pausing_replaces_the_firmed_line_before_tokenization`, and `no_new_control_sequence_guard_covers_source_and_csname_paths`, plus minifixture `input-tokenization-lifecycle.tex`, cover the remaining claims.
expected_observations: Physical M/N/S emission and exact ranges match canonical input; stored tokens bypass tokenization, substitute output parameters, resolve current meanings, and update alignment state; refill, pausing, force_eof, and guarded lookup occur at their exact boundaries.
postconditions: The physical or stored cursor advances by exactly the consumed representation and leaves the next canonical token available.
equivalence_cases: LF, CR, CRLF, and missing final terminator normalize to the same logical lines; control words, symbols, active bytes, and null names use their distinct lookup paths; source and stored equal tokens share resolved meaning but only source tokens undergo catcode and superscript conversion.
recovery_cases: Ignored, invalid, comment, invalid superscript, inactive endlinechar, force_eof, and forbidden new-control-sequence cases each consume or retire exactly the canonical input and cannot loop unchanged.

properties.claim: Expanded delivery preserves expandafter order, one-token noexpand, undefined recovery, csname construction, input lifecycle, exact backup, and x-token conversion.
preconditions: The exact TeX82 profile and explicit canonical command state are active.

cases: pinned first mismatch rejects XPASS and changed failure

expected_observations: Raw expandable events precede effects and only the final unexpandable command receives expanded delivery.
postconditions: Consumed input, scanner status, and replay ownership end at the cited canonical boundary.
equivalence_cases: Recursive expand and iterative get_x_token reach the same unexpandable command; macro calls and nonmacro primitives share the loop but use distinct dispatch; source spelling and csname spelling converge on one identity after name construction.
recovery_cases: Undefined expansion reports before frozen-relax substitution where permitted; missing endcsname stops name collection without swallowing enclosing input; backup preserves exact first/second-token order for expandafter.

properties.claim: Macro calls raw-match compulsory, delimited, and undelimited arguments with brace depth and overlap recovery, strip one outer group, then replay owned parameter ranges.
preconditions: The exact TeX82 profile and explicit canonical command state are active.
stimulus: Invoke parameterless, compulsory, delimited, undelimited, long, non-long, nested, and brace-delimited macros.
expected_observations: Arguments remain unexpanded, overlaps lose no tokens, and replacement parameters replay exact ranges.
postconditions: Consumed input, scanner status, and replay ownership end at the cited canonical boundary.
equivalence_cases: Source and stored arguments match by token value; undelimited single tokens and balanced groups differ in outer-brace stripping; delimited overlap and nonoverlap converge on the same captured argument bytes.
recovery_cases: Compulsory-prefix mismatch aborts without activation; non-long paragraph and extra-right-brace paths back up/insert canonically; a hash-left-brace delimiter cancels its duplicate alignment increment.

properties.claim: String/internal conversions create canonical spacer/other-character lists; the_toks copies stored tokens directly; conversion output re-enters input, while balanced stored-list collection delegates to `tex82.scanner.scan-toks`.
preconditions: The exact TeX82 profile and explicit canonical command state are active.
stimulus: Phase 2 unit `converted_token_lists_classify_spaces_copy_tokens_and_resume_expansion` plus minifixture `expansion-conversions.tex` cover all six conversions and token-valued the.

cases: pinned first mismatch rejects XPASS and changed failure

expected_observations: Rendered bytes classify canonically, token values copy without stringification, and inserted output resumes expansion.
postconditions: Consumed input, scanner status, and replay ownership end at the cited canonical boundary.
equivalence_cases: Equal rendered scalar bytes produce equal spacer/other-character lists; token-register and font-identity results copy tokens rather than stringify; all six classic convert selectors share insertion but not operand scanning.
recovery_cases: Invalid numeric or font operands finish their owning scanner recovery before rendering; string and meaning temporarily normalize scanner status so an outer operand is consumed exactly once.

properties.claim: read_toks tokenizes read lines into a parameterless stored list, disables alignment delimiters, continues across unbalanced braces, and supplies one final empty EOF line.
preconditions: The exact TeX82 profile and explicit canonical command state are active.
stimulus: Phase 2 unit `read_toks_collects_balanced_multiline_input_and_appends_one_eof_line` plus minifixture `input-read-toks.tex` cover closed, just-open, normal, balanced, and unbalanced streams.
expected_observations: The list begins with end-match, balance controls continuation, and scanner/alignment state is restored.
postconditions: Consumed input, scanner status, and replay ownership end at the cited canonical boundary.
equivalence_cases: Closed/out-of-range streams use terminal input while just-open and normal streams use distinct first/subsequent file reads; balanced single-line and balanced multiline input freeze the same token sequence when logical lines match.
recovery_cases: EOF contributes one final empty line; EOF with unmatched left braces reports and restores balance once; a right brace below the disabled alignment baseline consumes the rest of that line before returning.

properties.claim: start_input scans and defaults the filename, opens one provisional source level per attempt, retries the default area before prompting, establishes job/log and source context on success, and loads an empty or nonempty first line without the ordinary subsequent-line read mode.
preconditions: The expandable input command has host-provided deterministic file capabilities and no successful child source level has yet been committed.
stimulus: Phase 2 units `start_input_retries_names_opens_one_level_and_normalizes_first_line`, `start_input_failed_attempt_retires_only_its_provisional_level`, and `start_input_initializes_job_name_once`, plus minifixture `input-start-file.tex`, cover direct/default-area success, retry, empty file, inactive endlinechar, and nested input.

cases: pinned first mismatch rejects XPASS and changed failure

expected_observations: Each failed open removes its provisional level; success records the canonical name, opens the log only for the first job name, emits the opening context, enters new_line state, and exposes a normalized first line (a blank logical line for an empty file).
postconditions: Exactly one successful child source level remains above its caller with line one, loc=start, first=limit+1, and the canonical endlinechar policy applied.
equivalence_cases: Explicit .tex and defaulted extension requests converge on the same opened identity; direct-area and TEX-area success share the committed source state; empty file and one blank physical line share first-line tokenization.
recovery_cases: A failed direct and default-area lookup retires the attempted level before prompting; inactive endlinechar decreases the first-line limit; repeated nested input never replaces an established job name.
